infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Approx uses the camera to record Swift videos and take photos for your stories and chat messages. Nothing is captured until you press record or the shutter.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Approx uses the microphone to record sound with your Swift videos. Audio is only captured while you are recording, and only in the video you choose to publish.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Approx lets you choose an existing photo for your profile picture, a story, or a chat message. Only the photo you pick is shared — Approx never reads your library.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Only if you turn on "Keep sharing while Approx is closed". Approx then keeps your position current in the background, so people nearby still see where you are and you are told when someone is close. The same rules apply: friends see your exact position, everyone else an area of about 500 metres. It stops when you turn that switch off or turn on Ghost Mode. This is optional and nothing else in Approx asks for it.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Approx shows you people nearby who share your interests, and shows you to them. Friends see your exact position; everyone else sees an approximate area of about 500 metres, never your precise location. Nothing is shared until you have read a screen explaining this. Ghost Mode, in Privacy & safety, turns it off in both directions at any time, and your position is hidden from everyone once it is more than 15 minutes old.
